Name: Very large meadowlands farm
Author: Roseora
Description:
Comes with:
-Separated forestry areas for your fruit trees.
-A large river with pond ideal for rice and other irrigated crops.
-A LOT of space. Like, a lot.

Note:
I can't change the location of the coop that you start off with. It spawns in the river unfortunately. To get around this, you can move the building from Robins' shop, and use a mod like noclip to remove the fence. (Or wait for it to decay naturally if you don't want to use noclip.) I'm very sorry about this inconvenience. x

Alternatively, start in a vanilla meadowlands, move the coop and fence, then install this mod.  Or you can also start the game in a different farm type and switch to avoid the coop spawning at all This will however change  the paths layer and not allow blue grass. I've included notes on how to do this in the info file alongside the tilesheets and info on how to edit the map to your liking, so it should be as easy as possible to make your own farm map using this as a template!
